scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" build && pnpm --filter csp-demo build && pnpm --filter csp-northstar build && pnpm --filter csp-customer-template exec node ../../packages/cli/dist/index.js build
scripts.check: pnpm check:versions && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:docs && pnpm build
scripts.release: pnpm check:versions && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" publish --access public --no-git-checks
